knowledge_target: The actual file path for the setting model in the repository is `src/metabase/settings/models/setting.clj` (namespace `metabase.settings.models.setting`), not `src/metabase/models/setting.clj` as the task description stated. The `defsetting` macro is accessed via `[metabase.settings.core :as setting :refer [defsetting]]` as shown in `src/metabase/system/settings.clj`.
